Parse a Rust struct definition.

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"rust\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "struct Point { x: f64, y: f64 }", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
